item.title: GTA 6 Just Brought Back the Best E3 Meme of All Time
item.description: After years of waiting, Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and it's already astonishing players with its immaculately detailed environments, unexpected celebrity cameos, and absurdly interactive NPCs. Much like Leonida's various radio stations play all-time bangers and deep cuts, GTA 6 is also packed with references to memorable memes and pop-culture moments, and many of them are easy to miss. For instance, the game contains an homage to a hilarious viral moment from E3 2006, and it's not even a full-on side quest but a random discovery you'll stumble upon as you explore GTA 6 's intricate open world.

item.title: Should you defuse or provoke Mandy in GTA 6?
item.description: When you meet Mandy in Grand Theft Auto 6 for the first time, you can pick between the "defuse" and "provoke" dialogue options to determine how Jason is going to approach her during the conversation. This encounter takes place during the "Pipework" quest in Chapter 1. Jason is doing some jobs for Brian, who asked him to collect the rent from a couple of tenants. Mandy is one of them, but her condition for paying the rent is that her sink be fixed, and she specifically asked for Jason to come and help her.

item.title: Where to find strip clubs in GTA 6
item.description: There are several strip clubs in Grand Theft Auto 6 , but they're hard to find, especially if you're spending most of your time in Key Lento. Have no fear; if you can't wait to watch scantily clad women move to music in GTA 6 , there's an early-game strip club that offers private dances.

item.title: Fortnite Adds New Way to Get the Pirate Shop Token
item.description: The Pirate Shop Access token is the most sought-after item in Fortnite history, guaranteeing a total of four weeks of free Item Shop goodies. Nearly every player has been actively searching for it, opening as many chests as they can per match, even if it costs them their in-game lives.

item.title: RayNeo Built Modern Warfare 4 Its Own AR Glasses - And Put Call Of Duty Inside The Lens
item.description: The RayNeo GT Max Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare 4® Limited Edition lands November 19 at $449 - a 307-inch screen and an interface built for the game.

item.title: 20 Years Ago, Nintendo’s Awkwardly Named Console Defied All Its Biggest Doubters
item.description: Nintendo is a force in the video game industry, currently riding high with the Switch 2 , but it has had dips and missteps like any other company. After strong performances during the 8-bit and 16-bit eras, its performance started to slip with the powerful Nintendo 64, which gave unexpected ground to the PlayStation console that Nintendo itself inspired Sony to build. Despite the GameCube’s impressive tech, the hardware continued to bleed market share to new competitors, and it was clear something needed to change to avoid a fate worse than Sega.

item.title: LiberNovo Is Cutting The Prices Of Its Best Chairs By Up To 42% For Black Friday And Cyber Monday
item.description: Omni and Maxis models are both included in a sale that will save you hundreds of dollars on some of the best ergonomic chairs on the market.

item.title: Dead by Daylight Teases the Arrival of the King of Monsters
item.description: Behaviour Interactive has never shied away from bringing strange, completely out-there IPs into its asymmetrical multiplayer horror game, Dead by Daylight . The game has featured Tokyo Ghoul , Tomb Raider , and even — get this — Nicolas Cage. Yes, the actor.

item.title: How to change your criminal profile in GTA 6
item.description: To improve your criminal profile in Grand Theft Auto 6 , you must play nice. Since it's GTA 6 , though, "playing nice" means shooting folks in the knee rather than in the head. You'll still break the law, but you'll be more polite about it.

item.title: What to do first in GTA 6
item.description: The best things to do first in Grand Theft Auto 6 are all about money management, unlocking open-world activities, and taking good care of Jason's slithery friend. While there's no right or wrong way to play, these tips and tricks should make your first visit to Leonida, specifically Key Lento, more useful and fun.
